freeze_scope: Token IDs/configurations/exclusions/analysis fixed before new physical outcomes; implementation must pass new diagnostic before launch.
caveat: Windows 5-32 uninspected in this physical pilot, not globally unseen: canonical logical N32 evaluations already exist. Same fixed contiguous WikiText pool; not an independent generalization holdout.
effect: mean of paired window mean token NLL differences; relative PPL=100*expm1(effect)

inference.unit: window, all 128 paired targets kept together
inference.rationale: 97.5% two-sided intervals per co-primary schedule: Bonferroni family coverage at least 95% under bootstrap assumptions
inference.blocked_sensitivity: Resample fixed contiguous blocks of four windows: seven blocks for N28, eight for N32. No meaningful block CI for N4.
inference.caveat: Conditional benchmark uncertainty; contiguous windows can remain dependent across blocks. No independent-token CI or universal quality claim.

exclusions: None for quality, length, outliers, EOS, or unfavorable scores. Exactly 128 targets per window per cell. Invalid/missing/duplicate scores or gates stop the entire attempt; do not drop windows or pool partial attempts.
failure_policy: No automatic retries; preserve failed run. Diagnose before a new full four-cell paired attempt. Any inference fix requires new implementation version and full controls; amend freeze with reason before new outcomes, preserve this version.
validity: full identity hashes and dispatch/component gate
exact token IDs, positions, actual schedules, packed bytes/read/write/cleanup per request/layer
all NLL finite; exact score count=4096/cell, raw engine agreement <2e-5
BF16 aggregate PPL vs independent HF <=0.5%, report per-window and per-token discrepancies without exclusion
same-device dense/dequantized diagnostic gates pass; no unexplained first-target/control failure
quality_not_validity: No quality threshold filters results. Report any loss, CIs, and schedule interaction.
unforced_smokes: Separate fixed two prompts, tagged by kind; never classify scoring/free by window>4.

resource_plan.storage: Existing model cache read-only; ephemeral output, no new persistent model volume.
resource_plan.traces: Preserve complete path events sharded by window, with streaming per-window chronology/byte/count validation and summaries. Detailed diagnostic tensors restricted to window1. No silent truncation; planned 2GiB aggregate/64MiB per-file limits.

launch_blockers: N32 cloud worker generalization and offline integration required; old four-window launcher must not be used as N32

amendment.reason: Choose the inspected window with the largest absolute single-chunk first-target packed-minus-BF16 NLL discrepancy: window2 (0.05409669876098633), rather than arbitrary window1. This targets the dense-prefill control gap, not favorable quality. No N32 inputs, endpoints, exclusions, or uncertainty analysis changed.
amendment.timing: Before any new GPU diagnostic/evaluation or new physical N28 outcomes; original v1 freeze preserved.
